Author: Ilan Peer <ilan.peer@intel.com>

    wifi: mac80211: Support link removal using Reconfiguration ML element
    
    Add support for handling link removal indicated by the
    Reconfiguration Multi-Link element.
    
    Signed-off-by: Ilan Peer <ilan.peer@intel.com>

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces new functionality for handling link removal via Reconfiguration ML element. The code shows: 1) Proper bounds checking with ieee80211_mle_reconf_sta_prof_size_ok() before accessing struct members, 2) Validation that removed_links &= sdata->vif.valid_links ensures only valid links are processed, 3) Null check for link_conf with continue on failure, 4) Proper locking with sdata_lock/sdata_unlock, 5) Delayed work queue with proper initialization and cancellation. While there are minor concerns like the pos += 6 offset calculation without explicit bounds verification and potential integer overflow in link_delay calculation (beacon_int * link_removal_timeout), these are not clearly vulnerable constructs given the context. The code follows established patterns in mac80211 and includes appropriate error handling. Since this is a feature addition commit (not a bug fix), and no clear vulnerable construct is present in the shown code, has_bug=false.
